description: This PHP class 'testcaseCommands' manages test case operations such as creation, editing, deletion, relation management, step handling, and attribute setting within the TestLink testing framework. It interacts with database managers, handles GUI object initialization, and performs various test case related actions.

classes.name: testcaseCommands
classes.description: A class providing comprehensive management of test cases, including creation, editing, deletion, step management, relation handling, and attribute setting within the TestLink framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database, user, and project managers, and setting user rights.

methods.name: setTemplateCfg
methods.description: Sets the template configuration for the class.

methods.name: initGuiBean
methods.description: Initializes a GUI object with default properties for test case operations.

methods.name: initTestCaseBasicInfo
methods.description: Loads basic test case info, including author, updater, custom fields, and external IDs.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares GUI object for creating a new test case.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Creates a new test case in the database and prepares GUI for confirmation.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares GUI for editing an existing test case.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing test case with new data.

methods.name: doAdd2testplan
methods.description: Links test case to a test plan.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Prepares GUI for deleting a test case.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a test case from the database.

methods.name: createStep
methods.description: Prepares GUI for creating a new step within a test case.

methods.name: doCreateStep
methods.description: Creates a new step in the test case.

methods.name: doCreateStepAndExit
methods.description: Creates a step and exits, updating the GUI accordingly.

methods.name: editStep
methods.description: Prepares GUI for editing a specific test step.

methods.name: doUpdateStep
methods.description: Updates a specific test step.

methods.name: doUpdateStepAndExit
methods.description: Updates a step and exits, refreshing the GUI.

methods.name: doReorderSteps
methods.description: Reorders test steps based on provided sequence.

methods.name: doDeleteStep
methods.description: Deletes a specific test step.

methods.name: doCopyStep
methods.description: Copies a test step to a new position.

methods.name: doInsertStep
methods.description: Inserts a new step at a specific position.

methods.name: doInsertStep
methods.description: Inserts a new step at a specific position.

methods.name: doResequenceSteps
methods.description: Resequences steps either by provided sequence or by default order.

methods.name: setImportance
methods.description: Sets the importance attribute of a test case.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status attribute of a test case.

methods.name: setExecutionType
methods.description: Sets the execution type of a test case.

methods.name: setEstimatedExecDuration
methods.description: Sets the estimated execution duration for a test case.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the test case details in the GUI.

methods.name: buildIdentity
methods.description: Builds an identity object for test case referencing.

methods.name: doAddRelation
methods.description: Adds a relation between test cases.

methods.name: doDeleteRelation
methods.description: Deletes a relation between test cases.

methods.name: doUpdateStepAndInsert
methods.description: Updates a step and inserts a new one in sequence.

methods.name: removeKeyword
methods.description: Removes a keyword link from a test case.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Sets a test case version as closed.

methods.name: unfreeze
methods.description: Sets a test case version as open.

methods.name: setIsOpen
methods.description: Sets the open/closed status of a test case version.

methods.name: setActiveAttr
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a test case version.

methods.name: addKeyword
methods.description: Adds keywords to a test case, optionally linking to issue tracker.

methods.name: updateTPlanLinkToTCV
methods.description: Updates the latest test plan link to a test case version.

methods.name: doStepOperationExit
methods.description: Completes step operation and exits, updating GUI.

methods.name: addPlatform
methods.description: Adds platform links to a test case.

methods.name: removePlatform
methods.description: Removes platform links from a test case.
